issues.quote: I walk in the cold when I want to think, and I smoke Brissago, the cheap ones.
issues.fact: B2 says only that he went out to smoke at 10:21 by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house. It gives no habit of walking about.
issues.misreading: A solver could read the 'I walk in the cold' habit as hinting that he wandered off the spot during the 10:21 to 10:46 interval, which would contradict his fixed position under the front windows and could be taken as a whereabouts gap.
